home.tagline: Videos with voice-over, captions and music

home.empty_text: Write your own script. Tap New, name your video, then add scenes one by one or paste a whole script.

about.tagline: Turn your script into a short video
about.description: Code Reels turns text into short vertical videos with a typing animation, voice-over, captions and background music. Write your script, press Render, and share the result.
features: Typing-code, text, bullet, steps, quote, compare, stat and image scenes
Voice-over from your phone's own voices
Background music with a copyright check
Works offline (only the optional music check uses the internet)
how_to: On Home, tap New and name your video
Open the Editor tab and add scenes, or paste a script
Pick captions or music if you want them
Find your video in the CodeReels folder
about.author: John Michael Calabia
about.privacy: Your videos, scripts and settings stay on your phone. The only time anything is sent online is when you tap Check online in the music check, which sends a 20-second clip to the AudD service.
about.credits: Built with Python and Kivy. Icons and text use the DejaVu Sans font (free licence).
